In 1 BBY,<ref name="IV Date">{{FilmDate|IV|1}}</ref> in the midst of the Galactic Civil War and after the [[Battle of Scarif]], Luke Skywalker finally became a part of the wider galaxy when [[protocol droid]] [[C-3PO]] and [[astromech droid]] [[R2-D2]] arrived on Tatooine.<ref name="Episode IV" /> Both droids had known his father, Anakin Skywalker, before his fall, but C-3PO's memory of such events had been wiped.<ref name="Episode III" /> R2-D2 was in possession of the [[Death Star plans|plans]] to the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station|DS-1 Death Star Mobile Battle Station]], an Imperial [[superweapon]] powerful enough to destroy an entire planet. The plans had been entrusted to him by<ref name="Episode IV" /> Skywalker's sister, [[Princess]] Leia Organa. Both siblings remained unaware of each other thanks to their separate upbringings,<ref name="Episode VI" /> and Skywalker first saw her when R2 projected a hologram of her.<ref name="Episode IV" />

[[File:Darth_Maul_2_Star_Wars_40th.png|thumb|left|250px|Luke Skywalker began his Jedi training under Obi-Wan Kenobi, the Jedi Master who trained his father, Anakin Skywalker.]]
Organa also gave the droid orders to find Obi-Wan Kenobi on Tatooine, whom Skywalker had met over his years on the desert world. Meeting with him, Kenobi presented Skywalker with [[Skywalker lightsaber|Anakin's lightsaber]] and<ref name="Episode IV" /> avoided telling the complete truth<ref name="Master and Apprentice">{{StoryCite|story=Master and Apprentice (short story)|book=From a Certain Point of View}}</ref> about Anakin by claiming Vader had killed him. After<ref name="Episode IV" /> a stormtrooper execution [[squad]]<ref name="USW" /> killed Owen and Beru Lars, Skywalker joined Kenobi on his journey to return R2-D2 and C-3PO to Alderaan, hiring [[Captain]] [[Han Solo]] and his [[First Mate]], the [[Wookiee]] [[Chewbacca]], to transport them aboard their [[YT-1300 light freighter]], the ''[[Millennium Falcon]]''.<ref name="Episode IV" />

Skywalker began his Jedi training during their journey, though Solo was outspoken in his belief that the Force did not exist. However, before they reached the planet, Tarkin ordered the Death Star [[Destruction of Alderaan|to destroy]] Alderaan, sending out a [[disturbance in the Force]] made up of the millions of screaming [[Alderaanian]]s killed in the explosion. Upon arriving at the planet's remains, the crew of the ''Millennium Falcon'' were taken aboard the Death Star by a [[tractor beam]]. Onboard, Skywalker convinced Solo to help him [[Rescue of Princess Leia|rescue Organa]], while Kenobi confronted Vader. To give Skywalker and the others a chance to escape, Kenobi sacrificed himself, dying at the hands of his former apprentice but becoming one with the Force. When the Empire tracked the ''Millennium Falcon'' to the [[Great Temple|Rebel Alliance's base]] on the moon of [[Yavin 4]], Skywalker joined [[Battle of Yavin|the battle]] to destroy the Death Star, flying in [[Red Five (T-65B X-wing starfighter)|Red Five]] with R2-D2<ref name="Episode IV" /> and leading [[fourth flight]].<ref name="Duty Roster">{{StoryCite|story=Duty Roster|book=From a Certain Point of View}}</ref> After Solo knocked Vader away, Skywalker listened to the voice of Kenobi, using the Force to help fire two [[proton torpedo]]es into a [[thermal exhaust port]].<ref name="Episode IV" />

With the Death Star destroyed,<ref name="Episode IV" /> Skywalker and his friends became known as the "[[Heroes of Yavin]]."<ref name="HC 12">{{HelmetCollectionCite|12|Databank A-Z}}</ref> A short time after the Battle of Yavin, they fought in the [[Assault on Cymoon|attack on Cymoon 1]], during which he confronted Vader for the death of Kenobi and alleged death of his father. During their brief encounter, Vader realized Skywalker wielded his old lightsaber.<ref name="Skywalker Strikes Part II">[[Star Wars (2015) 2|''Star Wars'' (2015) 2]]</ref> Intending to learn the identity of his new enemy, whom he realized was the same pilot<ref name="Darth Vader 1">[[Darth Vader (2015) 1|''Darth Vader'' (2015) 1]]</ref> who had destroyed the Death Star,<ref name="Episode IV" /> Vader hired [[bounty hunter]] [[Boba Fett]] to learn his identity and capture him.<ref name="Darth Vader 1" /> When Skywalker [[Duel in Ben Kenobi's home|returned to Tatooine]] to recover [[The Journals of Ben Kenobi|Kenobi's journals]], he escaped Fett,<ref name="Star Wars 6">[[Star Wars (2015) 6|''Star Wars'' (2015) 6]]</ref> but the bounty hunter had still learned his name. That information taught Vader that he had a son, inspiring him<ref name="Darth Vader 6">[[Darth Vader (2015) 6|''Darth Vader'' (2015) 6]]</ref> to one day overthrow the Emperor with his son at his side.<ref name="Episode V" />

====Apprentice without a Jedi Master====
{{Quote|Remember, the Force will be with you always.|Obi-Wan Kenobi's spirit, to Luke Skywalker|<ref name="Episode IV" />}}
Seeking passage to the Jedi Temple on Coruscant, Skywalker and R2-D2 [[Rescue of Luke Skywalker|arrived on the "Smuggler's Moon"]] of [[Nar Shaddaa]].<ref name="Star Wars 8">[[Star Wars (2015) 8|''Star Wars'' (2015) 8]]</ref> The young Jedi was captured by [[Grakkus Jahibakti Tingi]], a [[Hutt]] [[crime lord]] who collected Jedi artifacts that he claimed to be the last remnants of the Order. When Grakkus forced Skywalker to open a Jedi holocron, he accidentally opened the Hutt's entire holocron collection, convincing Grakkus that Skywalker was the last of the Jedi.<ref name="Star Wars 9" /> Thus, the crime lord plotted for a colosseum match between the young Force-sensitive and a beast, eventually choosing<ref name="Star Wars 10">[[Star Wars (2015) 10|''Star Wars'' (2015) 10]]</ref> a [[Roggwart]]<ref name="Galactic Atlas">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]''</ref> named [[Kongo]]. After a training against with "[[Kreel|the Gamemaster]]," who taught Skywalker that the Coruscant Jedi Temple had been converted into Palpatine's palace, and [[IG-100 MagnaGuard]]s,<ref name="Star Wars 10" /> Grakkus forced Skywalker, introduced to the crowd as "the last of the Jedi," into the colosseum,<ref name="Star Wars 11">[[Star Wars (2015) 11|''Star Wars'' (2015) 11]]</ref> but the match was cut short when the Gamemaster activated Kongo's shock collar. In reality, he was an undercover stormtrooper [[sergeant]] named Kreel, as the Empire had taken notice of Grakkus's stockpile of Jedi artifacts.<ref name="Star Wars 12">[[Star Wars (2015) 12|''Star Wars'' (2015) 12]]</ref>

[[File:VrogasVasRuins-VaderDown1.png|thumb|right|250px|Skywalker, bereft of a master after Kenobi's death, searched for knowledge in the ruins of other Jedi temples across the galaxy.]]
Kreel was reinforced by a group of [[Imperial Starfighter Pilot|TIE fighter pilots]], but Grakkus activated a [[electromagnetic pulse]], knocking out their blasters and Kongo's collar. When two pilots tried to arrest Skywalker, R2-D2 threw him his lightsaber, doing the same for Solo, Organa, and Chewbacca when they arrived by launching out sabers from Grakkus's collection. When Kreel was distracted by Grakkus, the rebels were given a chance to escape, although the stormtrooper still reported everything he had learned about the young Jedi to Vader.<ref name="Star Wars 12" /> Having learned about a [[Jedi Temple (Vrogas Vas)|Jedi Temple]]<ref name="Star Wars 9" /> on the planet<ref name="Vader Down 1">[[Vader Down 1|''Vader Down'' 1]]</ref> [[Vrogas Vas]] from one of Grakkus's holocrons<ref name="Star Wars 9" /> and reading about it in Kenobi's journal,<ref name="Vader Down 5">[[Star Wars 14|''Star Wars'' 14]]</ref> Skywalker traveled to the world, but Vader learned of his journey from his agent, [[Doctor]] [[Chelli Lona Aphra]].<ref name="Shadows and Secrets, Part VI">[[Darth Vader (2015) 12|''Darth Vader'' (2015) 12]]</ref> During the [[Battle of Vrogas Vas]], Skywalker was unable to focus on learning from the Jedi Temple with Vader on the ground, and the Sith Lord killed many [[Rebel pilot]]s<ref name="Vader Down 1" /> and [[Rebel trooper|troopers]] in his pursuit of his son.<ref name="Vader Down 2">[[Darth Vader 13|''Darth Vader'' 13]]</ref>

While in the temple, Skywalker felt the presences of Kenobi and Anakin Skywalker, but he was then engaged by Aphra and Vader's two [[assassin droid]]s, [[0-0-0]] and [[BT-1]].<ref name="Vader Down 2" /> With the help of his friends, Skywalker escaped these agents.<ref name="SW13">[[Star Wars (2015) 13|''Star Wars'' (2015) 13]]</ref> Later, as he again walked through the temple, he heard Kenobi's voice and was warned that he should not have come to Vrogas Vas. Meanwhile, Vader dueled his rival, Commander [[Karbin]], and heard voices from his Jedi past.<ref name="Vader Down 5" /> Though the Sith Lord managed to kill Karbin, Skywalker and his friends escaped the Empire and Vader's personal agents. However, Skywalker was saddened that he would never have the chance to return to the temple, believing he had been close to a uncovering a secret.<ref name="Vader Down 6">[[Darth Vader 15|''Darth Vader'' 15]]</ref>

At some point after [[Mission to Vagadarr Prime (Luke Skywalker)|investigating]] a [[Vagadarr Prime|planet]] to see if it could help in his training, as the world had been mentioned in Kenobi's journal,<ref name="SW 28">[[Star Wars 28|''Star Wars'' 28]]</ref> and [[Mission to Ktath'atn|fighting]] the Force-sensitive [[Unidentified Queen of Ktath'atn|Queen of Ktath'atn]],<ref name="Doctor Aphra 8">[[Doctor Aphra (2016) 8|''Doctor Aphra'' (2016) 8]]</ref> Skywalker and his allies undertook a [[Battle for Jedha|mission]] to the ruins of Jedha<ref name="Star Wars 38">[[Star Wars 38|''Star Wars'' 38]]</ref> in [[1 ABY]].<ref name="Helmet Collection 77">{{HelmetCollectionCite|77|Highlights of the Saga}}</ref> While on Jedha, he and [[Chulco Gi]], who had wanted to join the [[Disciples of the Whills]], journeyed to the [[Temple of Central Isopter]], where the [[Central Isopter|death cult]] claimed to Skywalker that, with the Jedi destroyed, their shrine was his only hope at learning the Force. Although he gazed into the crater, Skywalker did not want to lose himself to darkness, but Gi was corrupted by the abyss's connection to the dark side, forcing Skywalker to kill his companion in self-defense. Skywalker left the temple after the Central Isopter informed him the dark side could lead to madness if he did not have a proper guide, warning him to not fall because of his importance. Although he came to the conclusion that he might not end up a Jedi, but that he needed to be content with that, the mission on Jedha<ref name="Ashes of Jedha 4">[[Star Wars 41|''Star Wars'' 41]]</ref> would not be the last time Skywalker grabbled with that question.<ref name="Star Wars 1">[[Star Wars (2020) 1|''Star Wars'' (2020) 1]]</ref>

====The Redemptoin of Anakin Skywalker====
{{Quote|No matter how far my father had fallen, I sensed that his turn to the dark side was not absolute. I knew Anakin Skywalker had followed his heart to a fault during his days as a Jedi. Our ultimate victory would rely on my belief that the same heart was still beating somewhere inside Darth Vader's armor.|Luke Skywalker|<ref name="Secrets of the Jedi" />}}
Over five Dagobah days after his death, Obi-Wan Kenobi had appeared to Yoda as a [[Force spirit]], asking the Jedi Master to take on Skywalker as an apprentice. While Yoda had wanted to train Organa, he accepted Kenobi's request to train him.<ref name="There is Another">{{StoryCite|story=There is Another|book=From a Certain Point of View}}</ref> In [[3 ABY]], three years after the destruction of the Death Star,<ref name="Timelines" /> Skywalker journeyed to Dagobah with R2-D2 in the aftermath of the [[Battle of Hoth]], having been told by Kenobi's ghost to go here to train under the Jedi Master.<ref name="Episode V" /> Upon seeing the young man, Yoda felt the hope that he would be the next Jedi,<ref name="Age of Rebellion">[[The Trial of Dagobah]] — [[Age of Rebellion Special 1|''Age of Rebellion Special'' 1]]</ref> although Skywalker's initial lack of patience nearly convinced the Jedi Master to reject him as an apprentice. Convinced to continue by Kenobi and Skywalker's protests, Yoda trained the young human<ref name="Episode V" /> for several [[Standard week|weeks]]<ref name="There is Always Another">{{StoryCite|story=There Is Always Another|book=From a Certain Point of View: The Empire Strikes Back}}</ref> until the prodigy felt his friends being [[torture]]d through the Force.<ref name="Episode V" />

[[File:LukeVSVaderB.png|thumb|left|250px|The secret of Skywalker's parentage was made known to him by Vader during their duel in Cloud City.]]
Ignoring Kenobi and Yoda's protests but promising to one day return, Skywalker [[Escape from Cloud City|traveled]] to [[Cloud City]] on the world of [[Bespin]], where he [[Duel on Cloud City|dueled and was bested]] by Vader. After losing his hand and lightsaber during the duel, Skywalker was horrified when the Sith Lord revealed he was his father, choosing to fall down an air shaft rather than agree to Vader’s offer to rule the galaxy with him. After being rescued by his friends—who had lost Solo after the captain had been [[Carbon-freezing|frozen]] in [[carbonite]] and taken away by Boba Fett—aboard the ''Millennium Falcon'',<ref name="Episode V" /> Skywalker was left in stunned silence over the truth of his heritage, not even noticing that Organa introduced his name to [[Baron Administrator]] [[Landonis Balthazar Calrissian]].<ref name="Star Wars 1" />

After she informed him about recent events, while he only told her Kenobi had not answered his call for help in the Force, the ''Millennium Falcon'' traveled to Rebel [[Rendezvous Point Delta-Three]], forcing Skywalker and the others into an [[Battle at Rendezvous Point Delta-Three|Imperial ambush]] masterminded Commander [[Ellian Zahra]]. While manning one of the freighter's turrets, Skywalker, overwhelmed by the truth of his parentage, accidentally lashed out in the Force, helping take out<ref name="Star Wars 1" /> a [[squadron]]<ref name="Star Wars 2">[[Star Wars (2020) 2|''Star Wars'' (2020) 2]]</ref> of [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter|TIE fighters]], which led to the [[Fourth Division]]'s successful escape to [[Backup Rendezvous Point Gamma-Nine]]. As the rebels discussed what to do aboard the [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate]] ''[[Redemption]]'', Skywalker stood alone with R2-D2, finding himself unable to connect with Yoda and questioning whether he should become a Jedi after all. Although scared as to what he could be if he was not to be a Jedi,<ref name="Star Wars 1" /> he received a replacement hand aboard the ''Redemption'' and had a vision of a robed figure grabbing his fallen lightsaber on Cloud City.<ref name="Star Wars 2" />

[[File:Star_Wars_2020_Vol_4_textless_cover.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Armed with a new lightsaber, Skywalker continued to train amid the Galactic Civil War.]]
Unable to find his lightsaber after returning to Cloud City but deciding he would be a Jedi without it,<ref name="Star Wars 2020 4">[[Star Wars (2020) 4|''Star Wars'' (2020) 4]]</ref> Skywalker traveled to the planet [[Serelia]] and located the woman he had seen in his visions, Verla;<ref name="Star Wars 5" /> after spending years being hunted by the Empire, the former apprentice of Ferren Barr had abandoned the Jedi path to live in hiding. After learning Skywalker was not like his Sith father, Verla tried to dissuade him from following the Jedi path to avoid the pain it could cause, yet he remained steadfast in his desire to help the galaxy, promising to never visit her again if she gave the location of a [[Jedi outpost (Tempes)|Jedi outpost]]. At the outpost on [[Tempes]], Skywalker located a [[Luke Skywalker's yellow lightsaber|yellow lightsaber]] but was confronted by the spirit of the [[Grand Inquisitor]], who had been forced to remain in the mortal realm by Vader. Nevertheless, Skywalker defeated the specter, returning to the Fourth Division with R2-D2 and his new blade.<ref name="Star Wars 2020 6" /> Nevertheless, after using the blade against the Empire<ref name="Star Wars 2020 8">[[Star Wars (2020) 8|''Star Wars'' (2020) 8]]</ref> and in an effort to rescue Solo,<ref name="Star Wars 13">[[Star Wars (2020) 13|''Star Wars'' (2020) 13]]</ref> Skywalker found himself in need of a [[Luke Skywalker's green lightsaber|new lightsaber]], building a new weapon with a green blade.<ref name="Episode VI">{{Film|VI}}</ref>

Vader, meanwhile, had gone on a quest to find who exactly had hidden his son from him,<ref name="Vader 2020 1">[[Darth Vader (2020) 1|''Darth Vader'' (2020) 1]]</ref> yet his mission ultimately taught him what had happened to his wife, Padmé Amidala, and that, even in her final moments, she held faith that the light side still existed in him. Consumed with sadness instead of hatred, Vader returned to Coruscant,<ref name="Vader 2020 5">[[Darth Vader (2020) 5|''Darth Vader'' (2020) 5]]</ref> where he was tortured by Sidious for his lack of devotion to him. Leaving Vader on Mustafar as punishment,<ref name="Vader 2020 6">[[Darth Vader (2020) 6|''Darth Vader'' (2020) 6]]</ref> the Sith apprentice came to regain his strength, capturing Sidious's assassin, [[Ochi|Ochi of Bestoon]], and traveling with him to the planet [[Exegol]], where he had learned his master kept secrets.<ref name="Darth Vader 2020 10">[[Darth Vader (2020) 10|''Darth Vader'' (2020) 10]]</ref> Once on the Sith world, Vader proclaimed that he was no longer an apprentice, yet he was defeated by his master,<ref name="Darth Vader 2020 11">[[Darth Vader (2020) 11|''Darth Vader'' (2020) 11]]</ref> leaving him to feel that his son needed to die for the future of the Sith to unfold.<ref name="Darth Vader 2020 12">[[Darth Vader (2020) 12|''Darth Vader'' (2020) 12]]</ref>

[[File:Conflict_and_Combat_FDCR.png|thumb|left|250px|Amid the Battle of Endor, Skywalker and Vader dueled before the Emperor.]]
After [[Rescue of Han Solo|freeing]] Solo from carbonite and defeating crime lord [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure]] on Tatooine, Skywalker returned to Dagobah, where Yoda became one with the Force, and the young Jedi learned Organa was his sister. Afterward, Skywalker promised to take part in the Rebel effort to destroy a [[DS-2 Death Star II Mobile Battle Station|second Death Star]], which was being constructed over the [[forest]] moon of [[Endor]]. Before the [[Battle of Endor]] could begin, however, he surrendered himself to Vader's custody, hoping he could turn his father back to the light side. Instead, the Sith Lord felt forced to obey his master, taking Skywalker before Sidious to turn him to the dark side. As the battle between the Empire and Rebels raged on the ground and in space, father and son dueled once more until Skywalker was consumed with rage, striking against Vader when he taunted that his daughter could be turned to the dark side if his son refused. Desiring to replace Vader with his more powerful son, the Emperor subsequently betrayed Vader by ordering the Jedi Knight to take Vader's' place as Sidious's apprentice.<ref name="Episode VI" />

Instead of killing his father, however, Skywalker affirmed he was a Jedi, earning the anger of Sidious who tortured him with [[Force lightning]]. Before Sidious could kill him, however, Vader returned to the light side to save his son, throwing his Sith Master down a reactor shaft to kill him. The defeat and destruction of the Sith at the hands of the now redeemed Jedi Knight Anakin Skywalker, allowed him to fulfill his role as the Chosen One. Dying in his son's arms, the man who was once again Anakin Skywalker became one with the Force, appearing as a Force-spirit to Luke alongside Yoda and Kenobi.<ref name="Episode VI" />

===New Republic Era===
====The Mandalorian and the Child====
{{Quote|If you choose the armor, you'll return to your friend, the Mandalorian. However, you will be giving in to attachment to those that you love and forsaking the way of the Jedi. But if you choose the lightsaber, you will be the first student in my academy, and I will train you to be a great Jedi.|Luke Skywalker, to Grogu|<ref name="Boba Chapter 6" />}}
[[File:Precious-Cargo-Card-Trader.png|thumb|right|250px|The Mandalorian Din Djarin became the guardian of Grogu, a youngling of Yoda's species who survived the Great Jedi Purge.]]
Ahsoka Tano was still alive, helping Sabine Wren on her [[Quest to find Ezra Bridger|search]] for the still-missing Ezra Bridger.<ref name="Family&Farewell" /> Following the fall of the Galactic Empire during the [[Battle of Jakku]],<ref name="Aftermath: Empire's End">''[[Aftermath: Empire's End]]''</ref> an [[Gideon's Imperial remnant|Imperial remnant]] led by [[Moff]] [[Gideon]] sought to capture [[Din Grogu|Grogu]], a Force-sensitive infant of [[Yoda's species]], for his blood.<ref name="Chapter 16">{{TheMandalorian|Chapter 16: The Rescue}}</ref> Before Order 66, Grogu had been a youngling in the Jedi Order before being hidden from the Empire.<ref name="Chapter 13">{{TheMandalorian|Chapter 13: The Jedi}}</ref> In [[9 ABY]],<ref name="Timelines" /> the Mandalorian bounty hunter [[Din Djarin]] took the Child as his [[foundling]], escaping the remnant and its hired bounty hunters.<ref name="Chapter 3">{{TheMandalorian|Chapter 3: The Sin}}</ref> Amid a [[clash on Nevarro]], "[[the Armorer]]" tasked him with returning Grogu to the Jedi after telling him about the Order.<ref name="Chapter 8" />

After meeting [[Lady]] [[Bo-Katan Kryze]], Djarin was pointed to Tano,<ref name="Chapter 11">{{TheMandalorian|Chapter 11: The Heiress}}</ref> who was on the world of [[Corvus]] to get the location of Grand Admiral Thrawn from [[Magistrate]] [[Morgan Elsbeth]]. Although she refused to train Grogu, Tano pointed Djarin to the Jedi planet [[Tython]], where Grogu could be able to reach out to one of the few Jedi left in the galaxy.<ref name="Chapter 13" /> Even though Grogu managed to connect with Luke Skywalker,<ref name="Chapter 16" /> the infant was captured by Gideon's remnant.<ref name="Chapter 14">{{TheMandalorian|Chapter 14: The Tragedy}}</ref> Leading his allies to [[Second rescue of Grogu|rescue Grogu]] from [[Gideon's light cruiser]], Djarin and his team found themselves under siege from [[Gideon's Dark Trooper platoon|Gideon's dark trooper platoon]], only for Skywalker and R2-D2 to arrive in Red Five. Cutting down every [[Phase-III Dark Trooper|third-generation design Dark Trooper]], Skywalker agreed to train Grogu, departing with the infant and R2.<ref name="Chapter 16" /> Grogu trained with Skywalker for some time at his under-construction [[Jedi Temple of Luke Skywalker|Jedi academy]], where Tano joined him in watching over the Child's growing abilities.<ref name="Boba Chapter 6" /> Ultimately, however, Grogu chose to return to Djarin rather than continue down the life of a Jedi.<ref name="Boba Chapter 7">{{BOBF|Chapter 7: In the Name of Honor}}</ref>

====The new generation====
{{Quote|He was training a new generation of Jedi. One boy, an apprentice turned against him, destroyed it all. Luke felt responsible. He just walked away from everything.|Han Solo|<ref name="Episode VII" />}}
[[File:LukeTeachingJedi-TheRiseOfKyloRen3.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Skywalker passed on the ways of the Force to a new generation of Jedi, which included his nephew Ben Solo.]]
Skywalker began to work on rebuilding the Jedi Order after the Galactic Civil War during the [[New Republic era|time]] of the [[New Republic]], eventually gathering a group of Jedi students, among them his nephew, [[Ben Solo]].<ref name="Episode VII" /> the [[Quarren]] [[Hennix]], and fellow [[human]]s [[Tai]] and [[Voe]].<ref name="The Rise of Kylo Ren 1">[[The Rise of Kylo Ren 1|''The Rise of Kylo Ren'' 1]]</ref> However, Luke sensed a growing darkness in Ben and eventually went to confront his nephew in the night. When Luke peered into his nephew's mind while he slept, he saw the machinations of the mysterious dark side wielder [[Snoke]] and Ben's darkness, which would lead to death, destruction, and despair in the galaxy, and, in a moment of pure instinct, ignited his lightsaber. Luke, whose [[Skywalker family|family]] had a history with the dark side, was quickly overcome by shame and regret, but before he could put away his blade, his nephew woke up, and, in the confusion of the moment, ignited his own lightsaber to clash with his uncle and brought down his hut on him.<ref name="Episode VIII" />

When Ben lashed out against his uncle, he destroyed Skywalker's [[Jedi Temple of Luke Skywalker|Jedi Academy]] along with most of its students.<ref name="USWNE">''[[Ultimate Star Wars, New Edition]]''</ref> Ben had emerged from the wreckage of his hut enraged about his uncle's actions, but he was horrified when a lightning storm appeared and [[Destruction of the Jedi Temple|razed the temple]]. Shortly after that, Hennix, Tai, and Voe returned on their starship ''[[Verity]]''. Sensing only Ben's presence, they confronted Ben, who told them Skywalker had tried to kill him. In response to Ben's evasive and confrontational behavior, they fought and pursued him. In despair and confusion, Ben turned to his friend Snoke.<ref name="The Rise of Kylo Ren 1" /> When Skywalker emerged from the rubble, he saw that Ben had burned the temple, but mistakenly believed that Ben had slaughtered most of his students while taking the rest with him.<ref name="Episode VIII" />

Ben fled the other Jedi students to become Snoke's student and contacted [[Ren (human)|Ren]], the leader of the [[Knights of Ren]], offering to join the dark siders.<ref name="The Rise of Kylo Ren 2">[[The Rise of Kylo Ren 2|''The Rise of Kylo Ren'' 2]]</ref> Tai, Voe and Hennix cornered Ben on [[Elphrona]], leading to a [[Battle of Elphrona|duel]] which resulted in Hennix's death. Reaching the Knights of Ren on [[Varnak]], Ben was deemed not yet ready by Ren,<ref name="The Rise of Kylo Ren 3">[[The Rise of Kylo Ren 3|''The Rise of Kylo Ren'' 3]]</ref> who allowed him to accompany the group to obtain a Force artifact called the [[Mindsplinter]] on the [[Minemoon]]. There, Ben succumbed to the dark side when Ren murdered Tai, making him kill Ren and then Voe, thus killing the last remaining Padawan. Now consumed by the dark side of the Force, Ben Solo became Kylo Ren and assumed leadership of the Knights of Ren.<ref name="The Rise of Kylo Ren 4">[[The Rise of Kylo Ren 4|''The Rise of Kylo Ren'' 4]]</ref>

===A ray of hope===
{{Quote|The rebellion is reborn today, the war is just beginning, and I will not be the last Jedi.|Luke Skywalker|<ref name="Episode VIII" />}}
[[File:Luke_training_Rey.jpg|thumb|right|270px|Though reluctant to train another apprentice after his nephew's turn to the dark side, Skywalker agreed to teach the Jedi arts to the scavenger Rey.]]
Sometime later, as [[First Order-Resistance War|war]] erupted between the [[First Order]] and the [[Resistance]] for control of the galaxy, an orphaned [[scavenger]] named [[Rey Skywalker|Rey]] approached Luke at the first Jedi Temple on Ahch-To, seeking to be trained as a Jedi, having been sent by General Leia Organa, leader of the Resistance, Luke's sister, and Kylo Ren's mother. Though Luke rejected her at first, he eventually agreed to train her. A Force bond that connected Kylo Ren and Rey brought her to the ''[[Supremacy]]'', where Kylo turned her over to his master, [[Supreme Leader]] Snoke. However, Kylo killed his master, and fought with Rey against his [[Praetorian Guard|Elite Praetorian Guard]].<ref name="Episode VIII" />

When Kylo usurped his master's power, Rey abandoned him and joined with the fleeing Resistance on [[Crait]], where the [[Battle of Crait]] had erupted. As Rey helped the few Resistance survivors escape aboard the ''[[Millennium Falcon]]'', inspired by Rey to new faith in the Jedi and the goodness of their cause, Luke projected an image of himself on Crait to distract Kylo Ren and the First Order. He warned Kylo that he would not be the last Jedi, naming Rey his successor, before becoming one with the Force. Luke's tale went on to spread across the galaxy as a symbol of hope in a dark time as the First Order rose to power.<ref name="Episode VIII" /> When Darth Sidious was revealed to be resurrected in the [[35 ABY|year]] following the Battle at Crait, Rey, who had continued her [[Jedi training]] under Leia Organa, and her companions in the Resistance undertook a [[Mission to Pasaana (Resistance)|series]] [[Mission to Kijimi|of]] [[Mission to Kef Bir|missions]] to find a way to safely navigate through space to Exegol, where Sidious's [[Sith Citadel|lair]] and his [[Sith Eternal|followers]] were located.<ref name="Episode IX">{{Film|IX}}</ref>

[[File:RiseSkywalkeradaption-voices-of-Jedi-past.png|thumb|left|300px|Rey hears the voices of late Jedi while facing Darth Sidious during the Battle of Exegol.]]
After learning from Kylo Ren that Darth Sidious was her grandfather and that she was a [[Palpatine family|Palpatine]], Rey briefly considered exiling herself at the first Jedi Temple as her old master had, but the spirit of Skywalker appeared before Rey to encourage her to confront her fear, teaching his student that it was the destiny of all Jedi and that he had been wrong about his self-imposed exile. Rey and a redeemed Kylo Ren, who renounced the dark side and reclaimed his birth identity Ben Solo, confronted Sidious during a [[Battle of Exegol|battle]] at Exegol. Sidious used their bond as a [[Force dyad]] to rejuvenate himself, but Rey was restrengthened when she reached out to and heard the voices of the past Jedi, allowing her to stand reflect his lightning to destroy Sidious and the Sith for good. Rey was killed as a result of the ensuring explosion, but she was revived when Solo gave his life for hers. Although the [[Skywalker family|Skywalker bloodline]] ended, their actions allowed the Jedi to prevail and prevent the return of the Sith. Rey chose to adopt the surname "Skywalker" when she visited the [[Lars homestead|Lars Homestead]] on Tatooine and saw the spirits of Luke and Leia in the distance.<ref name="Episode IX" />

In the aftermath of the First Order/Resistance War, Rey eventually gained the status of Jedi Master. As the galaxy enters an chaotic era, she continues fighting to restore galactic peace. As Master, Rey started to work on rebuilding the Jedi.<ref name="TSWB" />

==Jedi ranks==
===Main ranks===
{{Quote|After successfully passing a rigorous series of tests that challenged mind, body, and spirit, a Padawan became a bona fide Jedi Knight, a shining symbol of peace and justice across the galaxy.|Luke Skywalker|<ref name="Secrets of the Jedi" />}}
Members of the Jedi Order held various positions within the Order at times as they studied the Force and gained experience.<ref name="Convergence" /> These ranks included:
[[File:AnakinSkywalkerEpII-SWBC52.png|thumb|right|200px|A Padawan was a Jedi apprentice who trained to become a full-fledged Jedi Knight.]]
*'''[[Jedi Initiate]]''': A young child who was Force-sensitive would be identified at birth and taken to the [[Imperial Palace|Jedi Temple]] on Coruscant to be trained as a Jedi.<ref name="Episode I" /> They were to be put into classes of other Jedi younglings<ref name="Episode II" /> and trained together before being taken as an apprentice by a [[Jedi Knight]].<ref name="Clone Wars film" /> Younglings were not to be trained once they had reached a certain age, with the sole exception to this rule being Anakin Skywalker.<ref name="Episode I" /> Younglings would participate in [[Gathering|the Gathering]], which was the pilgrimage to the [[Ilum]] [[Jedi Temple (Ilum)|Temple]] to gain a kyber crystal for their [[lightsaber]].<ref name="The Gathering">{{TCW|The Gathering (episode)}}</ref>
*'''[[Padawan]]''': A youngling who had been chosen by a Jedi Knight or Jedi Master to train under their tutelage personally into becoming a fully fledged Jedi Knight. Their readiness was decided by the [[Initiate Trials]]. Padawans wore a [[Padawan braid|braid]].<ref name="Episode I" />
*'''[[Jedi Knight]]''': Once a Padawan has successfully passed the [[Jedi Trials|Jedi trials]], they were be granted the rank of Jedi Knight and went out on missions of their own, no longer under the tutelage of a master and may take on a Padawan themselves.<ref name="Episode I" />
*'''[[Jedi Master]]''': A Jedi Knight was granted the rank of Jedi Master when they had proven themselves. A select few masters were offered a seat on the Jedi High Council when they had shown great skill, wisdom and devotion to the Force.<ref name="Episode I" /> Some Masters became [[Sage Master]]s or [[Jedi Guardian|Warrior Masters]].<ref name="CL" />
*'''[[Grand Master]]''': The leader of the Jedi High Council, the position of Grand Master was given to the oldest and considered to be the wisest member of the Jedi Order.<ref name="Yoda DB">{{Databank|yoda|Yoda}}</ref>

===Jedi occupations===
{{Quote|I've trained all my life to understand the call of the Force. Through that understanding, I can serve the galaxy, whether as a lone Wayseeker or by taking on an apprentice.|[[Gella Nattai]]|<ref name="Convergence" />}}
Some members of the Jedi Order had specific titles and roles within the Order. These included:
[[File:KnightsAndMastersIcons.png|thumb|300x300px|Obi-Wan Kenobi, a Jedi Knight, amidst several Masters.]]
*'''[[Jedi Advisor]]''': A Jedi who worked as a personal [[advisor]].<ref name="Unlimited Power">''[[Unlimited Power]]''</ref>
*'''[[Master of the Order]]''': This position was assumed by the leader of the Jedi High Council.<ref name="Insider 199">{{InsiderCite|199|A Seat on the Council}}</ref> They had to be voted unanimously into the position by the council's members.<ref name="AbEverything">''[[Star Wars: Absolutely Everything You Need to Know]]''</ref>
*'''[[Jedi Temple Guard]]''': Headed by [[Cin Drallig]] during the Clone Wars, these anonymous Jedi guarded the Jedi Temple with [[lightsaber pike]]s.<ref name="JTG DB">{{Databank|jedi-temple-guard|Jedi Temple Guard}}</ref>
*'''[[Jedi investigator]]''': These Jedi were [[detective]]s who aided [[Law enforcement agency|police]] with the use of [[the Force]].<ref name="Tera Sinube">{{Databank|tera-sinube|Tera Sinube}}</ref> They also used [[SP-4 ISC crime scene analysis droid|crime scene analysis droids]].<ref name="Russo-ISC Databank">{{Databank|russo-isc|Russo-ISC}}</ref>
*'''[[Consular Jedi]]''': These Jedi devoted themselves to the study of diplomacy or science and avoided combat and warfare duties.<ref name="TVE">''[[Star Wars: The Visual Encyclopedia]]''</ref>
*'''[[Chief Librarian]]''': This Jedi oversaw the [[Jedi Archives]] and [[Holocron Vault]].<ref name="Jocasta Nu DB">{{Databank|jocasta-nu|Jocasta Nu}}</ref>
*'''[[Jedi seeker]]''': These Jedi searched the galaxy for Force-sensitive children in order to recruit them into the Jedi Order.<ref name="Jedi Lost">''[[Dooku: Jedi Lost]]''</ref>
*'''[[Jedi Sentinel]]''': Jedi who focused on small-scale, community matters.<ref name="Endless Vigil">''[[Endless Vigil]]''</ref>
*'''[[Jedi Guardian]]''':<ref name="Endless Vigil">''[[Endless Vigil]]''</ref> Jedi also known as "Warrior Masters."<ref name="CL2016">[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2016)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']]</ref>
*'''[[Wayseeker|Jedi Wayseeker]]''': Jedi of the High Republic Era who operated independently from the Jedi High Council and followed only the will of the Force.<ref name="Into the Dark" />

===Jedi military ranks===
{{Quote|The general is the one who gives the orders around here.|Clone Commander [[Grey (clone trooper)|Grey]] rebukes Clone Sergeant [[Hunter]], referring to Jedi General [[Depa Billaba]]|<ref name="Aftermath">{{TBB|Aftermath (episode)}}</ref>}}
At the onset of the Clone Wars, the Jedi, the guardians of peace and justice in the Galactic Republic, were chosen by the Galactic Senate, whom the Jedi owed their allegiance to,<ref name="Episode III" /> to lead the new Grand Army of the Republic. They were thus given either of the respective ranks in the [[Republic Military]]:
*'''[[Jedi Commander]]''': Granted to Padawans, who served as second-in-commands to Jedi Generals in the Grand Army of the Republic.<ref name="Clone Wars film" />
*'''[[Jedi General]]''': Granted to Jedi Knights and Jedi Masters, who served as the highest ranking [[officer]]s within the Grand Army of the Republic.<ref name="CL" />
